evidence.quote: Fees: No tuition fee (semester fee only)

notes: The uni-assist sentence on the application portal page and the checklist PDF concerns other programmes (Sustainable Business and Technology B.Eng., International Business B.A., Master's); the Sustainable Business and Law DAAD page explicitly states no cooperation with uni-assist, so applicationChannel is de-university-direct. The semester fee (approx. 380 EUR on DAAD page, 394.80 EUR for WiSe 2026/27 on the semester-fee page) is not included as tuition: the programme states there is no tuition fee. Documents: the pages give no document list specific to this programme for international applicants, so no documents fact was output.

note.fr: Vérifiez que votre diplôme de fin d'études secondaires (Baccalauréat) permet un accès direct à l'université en Allemagne via ANABIN ; s'il ne le permet pas, une année préparatoire (Studienkolleg) peut être requise.
note.en: Check via ANABIN whether your school-leaving certificate qualifies you for direct university admission in Germany; if not, a preparatory course (Studienkolleg) may be required.

evidence.quote: You can find out whether your higher education entrance qualification (UEQ) from your home country qualifies you to study directly in Germany or whether you will first have to attend a preparatory course ("Studienkolleg") by visiting the information portal on the recognition of foreign educational qualifications (ANABIN).

note.fr: Justificatifs : copie de la carte d'identité ou du passeport, certificat de langue anglaise (B2).
note.en: Documents: copy of ID card or passport, English language certificate (B2).

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 5.5
